name: subagent
description: Start an independent child session immediately. Return its persistent agent_id and this activation's job_id. Completion follows the returned delivery policy. Use send_message to continue the child, or job_output to observe this activation.

prompt.description: Complete delegated objective, scope and expected outcome.

agent.description: Optional role from the host role catalog. Omit it to use the catalog-declared default role.

forkContext.description: True forks parent conversation context; false starts fresh; omission follows the role contract.

workItemId.description: Stable logical task id for retries. Reuse only for the same assignment; use a different id for independent repeated work.

todo.description: Exact content of an existing in_progress parent plan step assigned to this child. Update the plan first. Successful completion closes this step once every child linked to it succeeds; failures remain open for the supervisor. Parent review belongs in a separate step.

resources.description: Capability-level resources reserved for this assignment. Choose capability IDs from the host-provided list; tool permissions are not resource capabilities. Declare files or directories when the child may modify them; omit only when the scope is genuinely unknown.

capability.description: Registered resource capability ID. This is not a tool permission or authorization scope.

value.description: Capability-specific resource value, usually a workspace path.

intent.description: Capability-defined access intent, such as read or replace.

modelProviderId.description: Optional model route from the host-declared child model policy. Omission follows the role and configured pool.

thinking.description: Optional reasoning level validated against the selected route.

delivery.description: Current completion delivery mode, ability to wake an idle session, remaining wake budget and effective wait limits.
